scope: Retained ONVIF analytics to bounded source-linked vendor tracklets and native CLI JSON

mission.goal: Make retained XML and RTP analytics useful as inspectable temporal observations without inventing physical identity or event authority.

authority.git: User authorized meaningful direct-main GitHub commits, without PRs. Expected-head non-force ref updates preserve concurrent work.
authority.query: Existing retained sources only; normal exclusive publisher opening/recovery may perform housekeeping. No missing deployment initialization or pending-effect reconciliation.

situation_roots.source_custody: Exact XML/RTP import identities and publication roots, frozen source interpretations, native originals when present, current deletion closure and durable authority.
situation_roots.assumptions: Vendor ObjectIds, module names, timestamps and geometry remain vendor claims. Caller source order is explicit context.

published_checkpoints.change: Pure projector, shared wire helpers, retained XML/RTP owner, contracts, architecture record and source integrity manifest.
Native tracks command, bounded JSON/schema, tested production renderer, process fixtures, user documentation and scoped validation handoff.

cases.question: Can retained analytics form temporal groups without a hand-authored tracking input?
cases.finding: Yes: deterministic named-module/integer-ObjectId runs retain every exact source occurrence and explicit break reason.
cases.qualification: Actual production parser/projector/renderer contracts executed; retained source owner and complete CLI not executed.
cases.stop_rule: Never infer identity, geometry calibration, coverage, absence, corroboration or event/effect authority.

cases.question: Can a later empty, changed or deleted source escape aggregate query verification?
cases.finding: Both complete ordered source sets and projections are reconstructed and compared under one nonrefillable budget, followed by durable-head/effect-store verification.
cases.qualification: Thirteen real-owner regressions authored and independently source-reviewed, not executed.
cases.stop_rule: Any observed source/custody/deletion/authority mismatch, limit or cancellation refuses the entire report.

contracts.source_flags: Ordered repeatable --xml-source ID@ROOT and --rtp-source ID@ROOT; exact distinct nonzero SHA256 pins required.
contracts.provenance: Derived association with vendor_claimed original leaves.
contracts.barriers: Independent source pins, generation/locator discontinuity, missing/opaque modules or lifecycle, missing objects, time regression/gap and transformation changes.
contracts.rtp: Inter-document continuation requires complete processing and adjacent exact packet-boundary evidence; empty/rejected/opaque documents interrupt continuity.
contracts.privacy: Raw module/ObjectId/vendor UTC fields are null unless --include-values yes; exact digests/handles remain. Debug excludes vendor strings.
contracts.time: Existing UTC-Z grammar, exact i128 nanoseconds and lexical preservation; JSON uses decimal strings for interpreted vendor nanoseconds.
contracts.output: All accepted frames and objects, complete source receipts, tracklet indices and break reasons; no successful prefix on refusal.
contracts.compatibility: Original XML, event, parser and RTP source encodings remain unchanged. No dependency or lockfile change.

budgets.exclusions: Opening recovery, directory traversal and metadata/open syscalls retain existing deployment limits and are outside indexed-read counters. Work units are deterministic/conservative admission accounting, not CPU time.
budgets.cancellation: ReplayCx and native runtime own admission, cancellation, deadline and drain. Pure grouping polls cooperatively; bounded serialization remains inside the original native request.

validation.proof_scope: Real production parser, projector, JSON primitives and projection renderer with genuine fss-core contracts. Namespace adapters expose actual included modules; no replacement parser, retained owner or runtime is supplied. Embedded wire tests overlap between targets.

native_attempts.result: rustc SIGKILL in unchanged genuine Asupersync 0.5.0 under shared-host memory pressure; no FSS source diagnostic.
Same dependency SIGKILL even without code generation; no FSS source diagnostic. Further heavy attempts stopped.

validation.source_review: Independent owner/API, RTP boundary, resource accounting, parser/runtime and real-process fixture review completed. Review fixes cover final authority check ordering, early aggregate shape refusal and once-per-document hashing.
validation.repository_gates: Repository-wide semantic-plane and architecture consistency gates are not clean: unrelated missing module declarations/cross-plane imports and unknown QSR stable-ID family remain. New feature modules and report schema are explicitly registered; broad cleanup is outside this feature.
validation.qualification: No native custody/CLI execution, physical-camera/Profile M conformance or release qualification claimed.
validation.scoped_clippy: cargo clippy --locked --offline -j1 -p fss-core --test onvif_tracklet_json_contract exited 0; nonfatal included-source style/dead-code warnings remain.
validation.source_formatting: Pinned rustfmt --check for every changed Rust file and git diff --check passed.

findings: Open bead status alone was not a reliable implementation map; substantial native ingestion, replay, tracking and evaluation already exist.
Retained analytics lacked the direct temporal source-linked query implemented here.
Unknown lifecycle and transport content must remain explicit association barriers rather than invented continuity.
Default JSON presentation can preserve navigable evidence references without disclosing raw vendor labels.

obligations.work: Execute pinned native retained-owner, CLI parser and actual-process tests against the unchanged genuine dependency closure.
Qualify physical-device/Profile M interoperability and complete the broader metadata and scene/event requirements.

unknowns: Native integrated compilation/execution is not established by passing production-source pure tests or static review.
ObjectTree merge/split/delete semantics, cross-source continuity and calibrated scene/event interpretation are deliberately not inferred.
A completed retained processing report is not a coverage or physical-absence witness.
invalidations: Missing/changed/deleted source custody, conflicting pins, source/report drift, authority drift or exhausted budgets refuse the current query.
A successful historical snapshot cannot authorize later access or effects without fresh custody and authority checks.
Broad FSS-046/FSS-077 beads remain open pending their full registered evidence.
